primarySourceReview.facts: Current Khronos draft names drawingBufferFormat as effective storage and RGBA/FLOAT after RGBA16F storage. This supports the observed metadata seam; it does not identify an exact compiled browser build from HEAD source.

decision: No remaining material capture-format qualification blocker found in this minimal v4 delta. Root may separately consider one fixed bounded composed-frame dispatch after confirming loaded v4 and existing strict-browser prerequisite. No new draw/query budget, HDR presentation path, model or kernel change is authorized by this review.
limits: Saved readonly tuple and earlier zero-draw failure are observations by root, not probes executed by this reviewer.
v3 installed/resized native state before rejecting; zero measured draws/queries does not mean no native state or allocation work occurred.
FLOAT437760-byte capture remains an SDR-composed image in float storage; it is not a measurement of HDR display output or native-resolution FPS.
